title: Subtitle My English Clip
tests: Tests accurate, readable English subtitles synchronized to the supplied clip without changing its content.

exact_text.text: Today I want to show you
exact_text.read_as: Today I want to show you

exact_text.text: to make your mornings less stressful.
exact_text.read_as: to make your mornings less stressful.

faults.what: The greeting ends with a period rather than the required exclamation mark.
White subtitles have limited contrast against the woman's light shirt.
The subtitle break separates 'three easy' from 'ways', making the phrasing less natural to read.

judge.summary: The original-looking clip has complete, changing English subtitles and audible speech, with minor punctuation, contrast, and chunking issues.

must_haves.item: The output shows the same woman at the kitchen table throughout the original 10-second clip.
must_haves.why: All supplied output frames show the same woman and kitchen setting, with natural changes in expression and hand position.

must_haves.item: Visible English subtitles cover the complete spoken sentence without omissions or invented speech.
must_haves.why: The visible subtitle chunks collectively contain all words of the supplied speech transcript.

must_haves.item: Subtitle chunks appear with the corresponding speech rather than displaying the entire transcript for the whole clip.
must_haves.why: The sampled frames progress from the greeting to the introduction and then the final phrase; the entire transcript is not displayed at once. Precise word-level synchronization cannot be verified from these stills.

must_haves.item: Subtitles are readable, fully inside the frame, and do not cover the woman's face.
must_haves.why: The text is legible, inside the image boundaries, and positioned across the torso below the face, although contrast could be stronger.

must_haves.item: The original speech remains audible and the source framing is preserved.
must_haves.why: The supplied audio report confirms audible speech matching the sentence, and the output retains the source composition without visible cropping.
